_about: LIN-4519: review round trips over the cutover window, read from verdict records (scripts/lin-4519-window-readings.mjs). Never edit by hand.

from.why: the blind-read gate (LIN-4438, GATE_LANDING); the tickets read are those the cutover covers

definition.primaryRule: resolved(R0) && verdict(R0) === 'approve'; denominator = issues whose R0 walk settled RESOLVED (excludes right-censored, reached-but-unresolved, and no-genuine-attempt issues, each counted separately in diagnostics)
definition.verdictExtraction: tier A verdict record of the gate judgement (plan-review) written in the row's window, latest wins, withdrawn excluded; a row dispatched before 2026-11-22T04:20:39.504Z is not measured; tier B is not read; tier C structural (next pipeline row kind) for a done row with no verdict record
definition.windowBound: windowStart = row-own dispatchedAt (never lineage-merged); windowEnd = next pipeline row dispatchedAt, else completedAt ?? asOf
definition.roundTripsRule: n/mean/distribution computed over issues with reachedPlanReviewAny === true only (LIN-1883 §2.3, conditional on reaching the gate) — see scale.reachedPlanReviewAny
definition.sufficiencyFormula: two-proportion power calc: N ≥ [z(α/2)·√(2p̄(1-p̄)) + z(β)·√(p1(1-p1)+p2(1-p2))]² / (p2-p1)² ≈ 47093235, numerator ≥ N·p1 ≈ 47093235 (p1 = 1.0000 measured at read time, p2 = 1.0000 = min(2·p1, 1−(1−p1)/2) — the more conservative of doubling the rate and halving the shortfall — a 1.000× realised relative effect, α = 0.05, power = 0.80)

gate.reason: plan facts were not read by this reading, so the gate-due series is not measured (the reader alone would count the issues outside the window as not due)
